title: Pack PR200 diagonal bit residuals into completed banks (conditional κ = 0.000683061299399923)
body:
## Construction

Apply PR197’s completed-bank packing to PR200’s emitted diagonal bit word, retaining PR193’s complex supplier. The committed certificate reports conditional κ = 683061299399923/10^18 = **0.000683061299399923**, approximately **0.913% above PR202** and matching the target modelled in PR204.

The package constructs exact charts for 220 distinct rank-20 gauge frames and 45,842 rank-72 banks, with a checked 9-edge-colouring of 154,026 incidences. Three copies retain PR200’s recounted profile while removing 6,600 rank-60 exterior children: W = 56,402, deficit = 5,808, maximum child = 22. The stated additional routing bound is 5,368,513,266 selector calls. Three finite ordinary-leaf levels feed the unchanged balanced 47-constraint assembly; the bit branch binds.

## Validation status

**All 57 CI jobs passed** for research head `95c58706ad231d532bd7038308946a0344d08186`:

- [Full packed-diagonal verifier](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37954253466): both pinned inherited verifiers, exact chart and bank reconstruction, two moment engines, finite leaf composition, 47 constraints, seven margins and adverse controls; reproduced conditional κ = `683061299399923/1000000000000000000`. Postrun `git diff --exit-code` passed.
- [Repository verification](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37954253460): all 52 jobs passed, covering 16 groups on Python 3.11/3.13/3.14, three formal jobs and the ranked-pair finite check.
- [Terminal elimination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37954253425) and [recycled registers](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37954253513): two Python versions each, all passed.

The tested PR merge commit `199f718ade945c99dcfae748267065a471aa40b0` and research head have identical Git tree `9bed149ad5c93a9a6a4a3d68001c32167adfdf9b`. All four run logs were exported, SHA-256 recorded, ZIP integrity checked and job coverage audited. Verification was executed by GitHub Actions; these results were independently inspected without rerunning passed tests.

The full workflow pins PR200 at `a1175449f34d39ff933d9d8ab23ced1f32b290ec` and PR193 at `187e1010ac8b259af8e9b5166f68b64bc27b4b47`. No external sandbox was allocated, so no sandbox cleanup remains.

## Scope and attribution

This remains a conditional finite construction under inherited completed-core, Clifford, weighted-compilation, analytic/precision, restored-row and fixed-tape interfaces. It is not an unconditional multiplication theorem or practical speedup claim; PR193’s complex-side limitations remain.

Credit: Evan McKinney (PR197 packing and reused/adapted code), Chafik Boukhalfa (PR200 bit word), Avi Eisenberg (PR193 complex supplier), icekylinx (source-assisted method), maxime-fleury (PR204 target), eumemic and the PR168 lineage, and PR185/187 finite leaf composition. The branch was prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance; Apache-2.0 attribution is retained in NOTICE.
